description: [Native ISP] List Native ISP orders with status (preparing, active, soon, expired), end date, days left and the issued static IPs. Connections come as JSON, a text export format, or proxy objects for Dolphin Anty, AdsPower or Octo Browser, one per IP. Renewals and new orders are made in the dashboard.

format.description: json (default), a text export format, custom with template, or dolphin, adspower or octo proxy objects.

protocol.description: Connection protocol. Without it each IP comes as SOCKS5 when it has a SOCKS5 port, else as HTTP; the url shows which.

status.description: Only orders with this status. soon means it ends within 3 days.

template.description: Template for format custom, for example %ip%:%port%:%login%:%password%.

name: isp_list_orders
title: List Orders Tool
